item.title: Truckie winched to safety after being trapped in floodwaters
item.description: One crew member was winched down, balancing on top of the cabin. The LifeFlight helicopter was supporting New South Wales State Emergency Service with flood-related rescues at the time when it was scrambled to Yunta in SA, about 200km south-west of Broken Hill. item.title: Have your say on heavy vehicle charges shake-up
item.description: The FLCB is an alternative approach that spreads the cost of road construction and maintenance over the useful life of assets. Image: darkydoors/stock.adobe.com Truck owners are now invited to have their say on a proposed new forward-looking cost base (FLCB) model for heavy vehicle charges. The FLCB system could replace the long-running pay-as-you-go (PAYGO) model from 2027-28 onwards, if transport ministers sign off later this year.
